records.alt_sql: SELECT s.StuID, s.Name FROM Students s JOIN Takes t ON s.StuID = t.StuID JOIN Courses c ON t.CourseID = c.CourseID WHERE c."Group" = 'DB' GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.CourseID) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Courses WHERE "Group" = 'DB');

SELECT s.StuID, s.Name FROM Students s JOIN Takes t ON s.StuID = t.StuID JOIN Courses c ON t.CourseID = c.CourseID WHERE s.Major = 'CS' AND c."Group" = 'CS' GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.CourseID) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Courses WHERE "Group" = 'CS');

SELECT i.InstID, i.Name FROM Instructors i JOIN Teaches tc ON i.InstID = tc.InstID JOIN Courses c ON tc.CourseID = c.CourseID WHERE c."Group" = 'DB' GROUP BY i.InstID, i.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.CourseID) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Courses WHERE "Group" = 'DB');

SELECT s.StuID, s.Name FROM Students s JOIN Takes t ON s.StuID = t.StuID JOIN Courses c ON t.CourseID = c.CourseID WHERE c."Group" = 'Math' GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.CourseID) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Courses WHERE "Group" = 'Math');

SELECT i.InstID, i.Name FROM Instructors i JOIN Teaches tc ON i.InstID = tc.InstID JOIN Courses c ON tc.CourseID = c.CourseID WHERE c."Group" = 'CS' GROUP BY i.InstID, i.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.CourseID) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Courses WHERE "Group" = 'CS');

SELECT s.StuID, s.Name FROM Students s JOIN Takes t ON s.StuID = t.StuID JOIN Courses c ON t.CourseID = c.CourseID WHERE c.DeptID = 'D1' GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.CourseID) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Courses WHERE DeptID = 'D1');

SELECT i.InstID, i.Name FROM Instructors i JOIN Teaches tc ON i.InstID = tc.InstID WHERE tc.CourseID IN (SELECT p.PrereqID FROM Prerequisites p WHERE p.CourseID = 'CS460') GROUP BY i.InstID, i.Name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tc.CourseID) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.PrereqID) FROM Prerequisites p WHERE p.CourseID = 'CS460');
SELECT s.StuID, s.Name FROM Students s WHERE s.StuID IN (SELECT t.StuID FROM Takes t WHERE t.CourseID = 'CS360');
SELECT s.StuID, s.Name FROM Students s, Takes t WHERE s.StuID = t.StuID AND t.CourseID = 'CS360';
SELECT i.Name AS InstructorName, c.Title AS CourseTitle FROM Instructors i, Teaches tc, Courses c WHERE i.InstID = tc.InstID AND tc.CourseID = c.CourseID ORDER BY i.Name;
SELECT s.Name AS StudentName, c.Title AS CourseTitle, t.Grade FROM Students s, Takes t, Courses c WHERE s.StuID = t.StuID AND t.CourseID = c.CourseID ORDER BY s.Name, c.Title;
SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Name, c.Title FROM Students s, Takes t, Courses c WHERE s.StuID = t.StuID AND t.CourseID = c.CourseID AND c.Credits = 4 ORDER BY s.Name, c.Title;

SELECT DISTINCT s.Name AS StudentName, c.Title AS CourseTitle, i.Name AS InstructorName FROM Students s, Takes t, Courses c, Teaches tc, Instructors i WHERE s.StuID = t.StuID AND t.CourseID = c.CourseID AND c.CourseID = tc.CourseID AND tc.InstID = i.InstID;
SELECT s.StuID, s.Name, COUNT(t.CourseID) AS CourseCount FROM Students s, Takes t WHERE s.StuID = t.StuID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Name HAVING COUNT(t.CourseID) > 1;
SELECT s.StuID, s.Name, AVG(c.Credits) AS AvgCredits FROM Students s, Takes t, Courses c WHERE s.StuID = t.StuID AND t.CourseID = c.CourseID GROUP BY s.StuID, s.Name;
SELECT c.CourseID, c.Title, COUNT(t.StuID) AS EnrollmentCount FROM Courses c, Takes t WHERE c.CourseID = t.CourseID GROUP BY c.CourseID, c.Title ORDER BY EnrollmentCount DESC;

SELECT c.CourseID, c.Title, COUNT(t.StuID) AS EnrollmentCount FROM Courses c, Takes t WHERE c.CourseID = t.CourseID GROUP BY c.CourseID, c.Title HAVING COUNT(t.StuID) > 2 ORDER BY EnrollmentCount DESC;
SELECT StuID, Name FROM Students WHERE StuID NOT IN ( SELECT t.StuID FROM Takes t JOIN Courses c ON t.CourseID = c.CourseID WHERE c."Group" = 'DB');
SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Name FROM Students s JOIN Takes t ON s.StuID = t.StuID JOIN Courses c ON t.CourseID = c.CourseID WHERE c."Group" IN ('CS', 'DB');

SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Name FROM Students s WHERE s.StuID IN (SELECT t.StuID FROM Takes t JOIN Courses c ON t.CourseID = c.CourseID WHERE c."Group" = 'CS') AND s.StuID IN (SELECT t.StuID FROM Takes t JOIN Courses c ON t.CourseID = c.CourseID WHERE c."Group" = 'DB');
SELECT InstID, Name FROM Instructors WHERE InstID NOT IN ( SELECT tc.InstID FROM Teaches tc JOIN Courses c ON tc.CourseID = c.CourseID WHERE c."Group" = 'DB');
SELECT c.CourseID, c.Title, c.Credits FROM Courses c, (SELECT AVG(Credits) AS a FROM Courses) m WHERE c.Credits > m.a;
SELECT DISTINCT s.StuID, s.Name FROM Students s JOIN Takes t ON s.StuID = t.StuID JOIN Courses c ON t.CourseID = c.CourseID WHERE c."Group" = 'DB';
SELECT s.StuID, s.Name FROM Students s WHERE s.StuID IN ( SELECT t.StuID FROM Takes t JOIN Courses c ON t.CourseID = c.CourseID WHERE c.Credits = 4);
SELECT s.StuID, s.Name, t.CourseID FROM Students s, Takes t WHERE s.StuID = t.StuID AND t.Grade IS NULL;
